title: SR-1.20 External security review before any public launch
request: Closes G20: OAuth server, tunnel exposure, device signing, rate limiting and setup channel have had no outside review. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: SR-1.01, SR-1.02, SR-1.03, SR-1.04, SR-1.05, SR-1.07.

tasks.title: Review commissioned and run
requirements: an independent reviewer tests the daemon, OAuth, tunnel, relay, device keys, bus injection and contracts
the reviewer is named in the public file only with their written consent, otherwise by firm

criteria.statement: The review report (or its public summary) is filed

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
